thread:
Emma (PM): Heads up — inbound request from a midmarket customer asking for an on-marketplace listing + a JS SDK bundle that includes typed helpers for streaming and function-calling. They also want SCIM + SSO provisioning to be able to onboard 200 seats quickly.

Ola (Sales): Yep, it's ACME Health. Willing to pay for Dedicated but wants quick self-serve onboarding first. Main asks: 1) marketplace listing (GCP/AWS) 2) JS SDK ergonomic API for streams + reconnect 3) SCIM group sync + SSO (Okta) with automation.

Rafael (DevEx): Quick triage — marketplace listing is mostly product + legal + infra (billing). JS SDK work could be scoped as minor vs major depending on whether we add breaking surface for typed streaming. SCIM/SSO is an enterprise feature; do we treat as P0?

Li (Eng): Rough engineering notes: JS SDK streaming helpers ~2-3 dev-weeks if we reuse the existing TypeScript SDK and add reconnect logic + examples. Marketplace listing varies; needs infra support for billing webhook and IAM mapping (~1-2 sprints coordination). SCIM full group sync + provisioning is larger — ~4-6 dev-weeks with RBAC mapping and audit logs.

Emma (PM): Proposed approach: split into three backlog items and gate each with clear launch criteria. Marketplace (track: marketplace/listing) — acceptance: billing flow tested, listing live in at least one cloud, docs + quickstart. JS SDK (track: sdk/js-streaming) — acceptance: sample app, typed streaming API, e2e test for reconnect+resume, published npm package. SCIM/SSO (track: enterprise/provisioning) — acceptance: Okta SSO + SCIM basic provisioning, automated tests, SOC review checklist.

Rafael (DevEx): Suggest tagging with customer impact and initiative labels: labels = ["integration-request","customer:ACME-Health","initiative:onboarding-automation"]. Also add priority:P2 for JS SDK and marketplace, priority:P1 for SCIM/SSO if sales says revenue depends on it.

Ola (Sales): Confirmed they need SCIM/SSO for HIPAA onboarding — that becomes P1. I'll open the contract trigger if ETA under 8 weeks.

SupportBot: New ticket created: #INT-1427 summarizing ACME Health asks. Linking to thread and assigning to Emma.

Emma (PM): Next steps: Rafael, can you produce a rough estimate and a minimal scope doc for JS SDK by EOD Friday? Li, can you draft technical risks for SCIM + an ETA range? I'll create the three backlog epics and apply the labels Rafael suggested.

Li (Eng): Will do. I'll call out compliance & audit log storage as risks.

Rafael (DevEx): I'll draft the SDK scope. Also propose a temporary workaround: we could provide a curated quickstart repo with helper code for streaming until we ship the SDK changes. That might reduce time-to-value for the customer.

Ola (Sales): That workaround would be great for sign-off. Thanks. :thumbsup:

Emma (PM): Ok locking this in. I'll create epics and set initial due-dates and link INT-1427. Adding note: DO NOT make breaking changes to public SDK surface; prefer additive helpers.

SupportBot: INT-1427 updated: epics created (EPIC-832, EPIC-833, EPIC-834).
